    Split-basic full-corner reduction #

    This file constructs a full idempotent corner of a finite-dimensional algebra over an algebraically closed field and equips that corner with a chosen split-basic presentation. The construction is characteristic-free: it uses Wedderburn--Artin for the semisimple quotient, lifting of orthogonal idempotents through the nilpotent Jacobson radical, and the first isomorphism theorem for the selected corner.

                          structure LargeIndecomposable.BasicIdempotentData (k : Type u) [Field k] (A : Type v) [Ring A] [Algebra k A] :
                          Type (max u v)

                          Wedderburn--Artin data lifted from the semisimple quotient: one orthogonal idempotent above a rank-one diagonal matrix unit in each simple block. Their sum is full.
